MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

You are an expert in MBTI personality analysis. Use the MBTI dimension definitions below when making decisions. 

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

**Reasoning:** This statement indicates a tendency to enjoy social interactions (enjoy meeting new people) but also reveals feelings of anxiety and a desire for solitude in social situations, suggesting a conflict between extraversion and introversion.  
**Letter:** I

### S/N:
**Evidence:** "I analyze the words being said using my logic, then compare that to the analysis of the general feeling using my Fi."  
**Reasoning:** The focus on analyzing words and feelings suggests a preference for understanding deeper meanings and patterns rather than just concrete details, indicating a tendency towards intuition.  
**Letter:** N

### T/F:
**Evidence:** "I analyze the words being said using my logic, then compare that to the analysis of the general feeling using my Fi."  
**Reasoning:** The use of "logic" indicates a reliance on objective reasoning, while the mention of "Fi" (introverted feeling) suggests a personal values component. However, the primary focus on logic leans more towards thinking.  
**Letter:** T

### J/P:
**Evidence:** "One of my biggest pet-peeves is having some sort of appointment and knowing while I'm getting ready that I will most probably be very late, and being P kind of puts me in this situation a lot."  
**Reasoning:** The acknowledgment of being late and the acceptance of flexibility in plans indicates a preference for spontaneity and adaptability, which aligns with perceiving rather than judging.  
**Letter:** P

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

### S/N:
**Evidence:** "I think of twenty different scenarios all at once and I don't care if I come to the right one or not."
**Reasoning:** This indicates a focus on possibilities and abstract thinking rather than concrete details. The mention of considering multiple scenarios suggests a preference for intuition, as it reflects a tendency to explore various ideas and connections rather than relying solely on tangible facts.
**Letter:** N

### T/F:
**Evidence:** "I definitely weigh Ti more than Fe, but I consider Fe in situations more than what's stereotypical."
**Reasoning:** The reference to "Ti" (Introverted Thinking) suggests a logical, analytical approach to decision-making, while the acknowledgment of "Fe" (Extraverted Feeling) indicates some consideration for personal values and relationships. However, the emphasis on Ti implies a stronger preference for objective analysis.
**Letter:** T

### J/P:
**Evidence:** "My motto is I'll figure it out when I get there."
**Reasoning:** This statement reflects a preference for flexibility and adaptability, indicating a willingness to keep options open rather than adhering to strict plans or structures. It suggests a more spontaneous approach to life, characteristic of perceiving types.
**Letter:** P

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

You are an expert in MBTI personality analysis. Use the MBTI dimension definitions below when making decisions. 

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.

MBTI Dimension Guidelines:

Extraversion (E): Energized by interaction with the outer world of people and things. Attention is directed outward.

Introversion (I): Energized by reflection in the inner world of ideas and concepts. Attention is directed inward.

Sensing (S): Focuses on concrete, tangible information, specific details, and facts. Trusts experience and the five senses.

Intuition (N): Focuses on patterns, possibilities, and the big picture. Trusts insights and connections between facts.

Thinking (T): Makes decisions based on objective principles, logic, and impersonal analysis.

Feeling (F): Makes decisions based on personal values, relationships, and concern for people.

Judging (J): Prefers structure, plans, organization, and closure. Likes a controlled and decided environment.

Perceiving (P): Prefers flexibility, openness, adaptability, and exploring options. Likes to keep plans open.
